in_english.name: Shafa
in_english.meaning: Shafa is a means of presenting a prayer on behalf of others to God
in_english.long_meaning: Shafa refers to the act of presenting a prayer on behalf of others to God. It is a means of intercession, where one person presents the prayer of another to God. In Islamic tradition, shafa is considered a virtuous act, as it is a means of helping others in their spiritual journey. It is also believed to be a means of gaining Allah's mercy and forgiveness. The term shafa is derived from the Arabic root "sh-f-aa", which means "to present" or "to offer". In the Quran, shafa is mentioned as a means of seeking forgiveness and mercy from Allah. In Islamic mysticism, shafa is considered a means of spiritual growth and self-purification.
